literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines godet as an inset of cloth placed in a seam to give fullness, e.g. at the bottom of a skirt (godet L38). MW defines dart as a stitched tapering garment fold (dart L73), pleat as a cloth fold made by doubling material over itself (pleat L64), and lapel as the turned-back front of a coat, usually a collar continuation (lapel L38-L40). The overlapping gusset answer has been removed; the remaining three terms are distinct apparel details.
